title: Submission
description: A miner's answer to one job: the steps the task splits into, when each starts and ends, and a caption per step saying what was done, to which object, with which hand.

miner_hotkey.description: The miner's SS58 hotkey, which signs the request that carries this document.

method.description: How the work was done. Optional and never scored: the network pays for the output.

steps.description: In time order. Steps may leave gaps but must not overlap.

action.description: A verb phrase in the present tense: "pick up", "fold in half".

object.description: The thing acted on: "towel", "left corner of the towel".
